## Automatic production setup

Agents now download and verify the latest stable skill release before planning a new video. Each production keeps a private snapshot and version lock, so rerenders and series segments use the same tools. Production commands enforce the pin. Existing media retains its current tools, and installed skills and local edits are preserved.

## More readable component videos

Code excerpts come from real source ranges and stay visible through their narrated explanation plus a reading pause. Preview every app state and code excerpt in both orientations before generating audio. Wait for explicit completion, review every code reveal, and use the macOS-style pointer. Narration style advice no longer blocks valid scripts; audio and transcript checks remain required.

Both Codex and Claude archives include file manifests, release provenance, and SHA-256 checksums. Updates are checked only for new productions; active productions remain pinned.
